4.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: I’d count the Second Great War as the full StarCraft II conflict: it begins with the renewed zerg offensive in 2504 and runs through the defeat of Amon in 2506. That spans more than one full year but less than three, so rounded up it comes to 2 years.

In Koprulu canon the conflict that the community and the manuals call the
Second Great War / the Brood War is the post-Overmind Zerg / Terran /
Protoss war that follows the First Great War of the StarCraft I campaign.

In-universe the war is dated essentially to the death of the Overmind in
mid-2500 and the final Terran / Protoss consolidation on Char / Korhal IV
in 2501-2502.  That is

* start ~ July/Aug 2500 with the fragmentation of the Overmind and the
rise of the Queen of Blades, and
* effective end with the Battle of Char and the rout of Kerrigan’s
broods in ~ spring 2502,

i.e. ~18-24 months of open operations, about 1 y 8 m – 2 y of
continuous fighting. 

The usual shorthand is ≈ 2 y of war, 1.7-2.0 y of elapsed time.  On an
inclusive calendar count 2500-2502 is three calendar years, which is the
2 y rounded-up figure that is quoted in the field manuals.

2.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the Koprulu sector canon the war that Blizzard/ the
manuals call the Terran-Zerg Second Great War is the Wings-of-Liberty / Heart-of-the-Swarm conflict. 

Canonically it is dated to the Dominion-Zerg flare-up that opens with the
Dominion/Zerg crisis on the wake of Brood War and runs through the
Wings of Liberty campaign. The opening incidents are placed in 2504 and the
military-political denouement that is usually taken as the close of the
Second Great War is placed in 2505, i.e. the Mar-Sara / Char / Korhal
sequence that is played out in Wings of Liberty.

That is ~ 12-15 months of in-universe fighting, i.e. < 2 yr. On a
strict “years rounded up” convention that is 2 calendar years, 2504-2505
inclusive. 

If the wider Second Great War is taken to run to the end of the
Heart-of-the-Swarm phase, 2504 → 2506/2507, the in-universe span is ~3
yr, which is 4 yr on a round-up convention. The commonly quoted
Wings-of-Liberty-only figure is the ~1 yr → 2 yr rounded figure.

Great War is the Terran-Zerg war that follows the First Great War of SC I.

Canonically the war is placed immediately after the events of StarCraft I
and before the opening of Wings of Liberty.  The Field Manual / chronology
places the opening moves of the Second Great War in late 2501/early
2502 with the fracturing of the Terran Dominion, the breakout of the
various Zerg broods and the Terran civil war, and it is closed out with

2501-2503, i.e. ~1.3 yr of elapsed time which rounds up to 2 yr of
calendar time, 3 calendar years inclusive 2501→2503.  This is the
~2 yr Brood War that is usually quoted as the Second Great War.
